items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: The Artie shot, I would say probably had more effect on all of us than anybody else, short of Hines.

ctx.x: Well then he joined these Chicago fellows with Red Nickels and then he gradually becomes a Chicago. Yeah. By, but he does come out of the clear, the clear blue. You don't know quite how he happened to get into, amongst the Chicago fellows. I hope I get a talk with him and discover his first contact with Chicago.

You'll have to pick just the right day and early in it. The Artie shot, I would say probably had more effect on all of us than anybody else, short of Hines. And I guess, I can't figure out what records necessarily those were unless they were the Georgians. And I'm not sure that the Georgians were that well known.

No, but of course the Red Nickels. Yeah, he was on some of them. When 28 began to introduce Shutt, but you think that the influence was felt earlier than that. You had heard Shutt in New York as early as 25 or 26, hadn't you?
